name: Birth Certificate
issuing_office: Registrar of Births and Deaths of the municipality or Gram Panchayat
department: Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department / local registration authority
processing_time: 30 days
online_process: Online or assisted application through JharSewa / Pragya Kendra; registration with the local Registrar https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?grievDefined=1&serviceId=2270001&state=20&tempId=328&templStatus=243
offline_process: Local Registrar of Births and Deaths / Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Home birth: ward councillor certificate and parents' oath letter; hospital birth: hospital certificate and parents' oath letter; other cases: oath letter and supporting birth evidence as applicable.
eligibility: Parent, guardian, informant or other person responsible for reporting a birth in Jharkhand.
verification_notes: Current JharSewa service detail supplies the route-specific checklist and a 30-day timeline. The fee cell is blank because the current service detail does not publish a government fee.

name: Death Certificate
issuing_office: Registrar of Births and Deaths of the municipality or Gram Panchayat
department: Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department / local registration authority
processing_time: 30 days
online_process: Online or assisted application through JharSewa / Pragya Kendra; registration with the local Registrar https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?serviceId=2280001
offline_process: Local Registrar of Births and Deaths / Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Home death: ward councillor certificate; hospital or mortuary death: institutional death certificate; accidental or medico-legal case: post-mortem report or FIR; supporting identity and declaration as applicable.
eligibility: Relative, informant, hospital, mortuary or other person responsible for reporting a death in Jharkhand.
verification_notes: Current JharSewa service detail gives separate evidence for home, institutional and medico-legal deaths and a 30-day timeline.

name: Marriage Certificate
department: Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms
online_process: Online or assisted application followed by appearance before the Marriage Officer when required https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?serviceId=9580002
offline_process: Marriage Officer / Sub-Registrar Office
required_documents: Age proof of both spouses; photographs and signatures of spouses; wedding photograph and invitation card or Pandit/Qazi certificate; local-body or gazetted-officer certificate; identity and address proof of spouses and three witnesses; witness photographs and signatures; BPL proof where applicable.
eligibility: Spouses seeking registration under the applicable Hindu Marriage Act or Special Marriage Act route and meeting the jurisdiction and statutory conditions.
verification_notes: The current JharSewa page provides a substantial common checklist. Separate current fee and timeline treatment for Hindu Marriage Act and Special Marriage Act pathways is not exposed on that page.

name: Legal Heir / Succession Certificate
department: District Judiciary
online_process: Petition before the competent District Judge / civil court https://jharkhandhighcourt.nic.in/displayboard.php
offline_process: Jurisdictional District Court
required_documents: Death certificate; deceased's ordinary residence; names and addresses of family or near relatives; facts establishing the applicant's right; details of debts and securities; petition, identity and supporting relationship or estate evidence.
eligibility: A person claiming a right to the deceased person's debts, securities or estate and entitled to petition the competent court.
verification_notes: Jharkhand's current e-District catalogue does not expose a standalone statewide legal-heir certificate. This row documents the court succession-certificate route and the statutory petition particulars; court fee and case duration are case-specific.

name: Aadhaar Card
issuing_office: UIDAI through Aadhaar Seva Kendra / authorised enrolment centre
department: Unique Identification Authority of India
fee: Enrolment ₹0; biometric update ₹125; demographic update ₹75; document update at centre ₹75; colour Aadhaar print ₹40. Online document update on myAadhaar is free until 14 June 2027.
online_process: At an Aadhaar centre; selected document and demographic services through myAadhaar https://appointments.uidai.gov.in/bookappointment.aspx
offline_process: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / authorised enrolment centre
required_documents: Original Proof of Identity, Proof of Address, Proof of Relationship and Date of Birth documents as applicable to the enrolment or update request; Aadhaar number for updates.
eligibility: A resident of India for enrolment; an Aadhaar holder for demographic, biometric or document update.
verification_notes: UIDAI's current Aadhaar Seva Kendra page publishes the national fee schedule. The online document-update waiver date is also stated by UIDAI.

name: PAN Card
department: Income Tax Department
processing_time: Generally instant after successful Aadhaar verification
online_process: Online Instant e-PAN request on the Income Tax e-Filing portal https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/all-topics/e-filing-services/instant-e-pan/instant-UM?mobile-app=1
required_documents: Aadhaar number and access to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP and e-KYC.
eligibility: An individual who does not already have PAN, has a valid Aadhaar with linked mobile number, is not a minor and is not a representative assessee can use Instant e-PAN.
verification_notes: This row documents the official free Instant e-PAN route. Physical PAN application channels have separate charges and are outside the fee stated here.

name: Voter ID / EPIC
department: Election Commission of India / Chief Electoral Officer, Jharkhand
online_process: Form 6 online or through the Electoral Registration Officer / Booth Level Officer https://voters.eci.gov.in/home/forms
offline_process: Electoral Registration Officer / Booth Level Officer
required_documents: Recent photograph; proof of date of birth; proof of ordinary residence; Aadhaar if voluntarily provided or the prescribed declaration when Aadhaar is unavailable.
eligibility: An Indian citizen aged 18 years or more on a qualifying date and ordinarily resident in the constituency.
verification_notes: Current ECI Form 6 establishes eligibility and the proof categories.

name: Passport
issuing_office: Regional Passport Office, Ranchi / Passport Seva Kendras
department: Ministry of External Affairs
fee: Fresh/reissue 36-page, 10-year passport ₹2,500; 60-page passport ₹3,500; minor 36-page passport ₹1,750; Tatkaal additional fee ₹2,500.
online_process: Online application and payment followed by appointment at PSK / POPSK https://www.passportindia.gov.in/AppOnlineProject/user/RegistrationBaseAction?request_locale=en
offline_process: Regional Passport Office, Ranchi / PSK / POPSK
required_documents: Proof of present address; proof of date of birth; identity and citizenship evidence; old passport for reissue; prescribed annexures or additional documents for the applicant category and reason for reissue.
eligibility: Indian citizens applying for a fresh passport, reissue or eligible related service.
verification_notes: Passport Seva's fee page states the schedule effective 1 July 2026. The official POPSK list was used to identify Jharkhand locations.

name: Caste Certificate
issuing_office: Competent Circle, Sub-Divisional or district authority
department: Department of Personnel, Administrative Reforms and Rajbhasha / district administration
processing_time: Usually 30 days; OBC cases requiring local inspection may take up to 45 days
online_process: Online or assisted application through JharSewa / Pragya Kendra https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?serviceId=10290003
offline_process: Circle Office / Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Identity proof; proof of citizenship; proof of permanent residence; caste or lineage evidence; self-declaration; prior family certificate where available; justification for Tatkal processing where requested.
eligibility: Jharkhand residents claiming recognition under the applicable Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe or Other Backward Class route.
verification_notes: Separate JharSewa pages were checked for ST, SC and OBC. The combined row preserves the shared evidence categories and flags the longer OBC inspection scenario; current government fee is not published on the checked service pages.

name: Income Certificate
department: District Administration
processing_time: 30 days
online_process: Online or assisted application through JharSewa / Pragya Kendra https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?serviceId=2590003
offline_process: Circle / Anchal Office or Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Salary slip or other income evidence; income affidavit; parent or guardian affidavit where applicable; previous income certificate where applicable; supporting identity and residence evidence; Tatkal justification where requested.
eligibility: A Jharkhand resident requiring certified family or personal income for an eligible purpose.
verification_notes: Current JharSewa service detail supplies the evidence categories and a 30-day timeline.

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate
department: District Administration
processing_time: 30 days
online_process: Online or assisted application through JharSewa / Pragya Kendra https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?serviceId=11180005
offline_process: Circle / Anchal Office or Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Residential proof; self-declaration or pledge; identity evidence; supporting records establishing residence; Tatkal justification where requested.
eligibility: A person claiming Jharkhand residence under the applicable local-resident rules.
verification_notes: Current JharSewa service detail supplies the checklist and 30-day timeline.

name: EWS Certificate
department: District Administration
online_process: Online or assisted application through JharSewa / Pragya Kendra https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?serviceId=10300009
offline_process: Circle / Anchal Office or Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Identity proof; self-declaration; residence evidence; income and asset evidence; caste certificate for EBC-I or BC-II where the service route requests it; Tatkal justification where requested.
eligibility: A Jharkhand resident seeking EWS certification and satisfying the applicable income, asset and non-reserved-category criteria.
verification_notes: The current JharSewa page supports eligibility evidence and the checklist. It does not publish a current fee or service timeline.

name: Ration Card
issuing_office: District Supply Officer / Block Supply Officer
department: Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs
online_process: Online through JSFSS / Aahar or assisted submission through the food-supply administration https://jsfss.jharkhand.gov.in/
offline_process: District / Block Supply Office
required_documents: Aadhaar details of household members; household and address details; inclusion/exclusion self-declaration; mobile number; bank details and supporting eligibility documents where the form requests them.
eligibility: A Jharkhand household meeting the applicable inclusion and exclusion criteria for AAY, PHH or Green ration-card coverage.
verification_notes: Jharkhand's official application forms identify the application as free and capture household eligibility data. A single current statewide disposal SLA was not published on the checked service channels.

name: Old Age / Widow Pension
issuing_office: District Social Security / competent sanctioning authority
department: Department of Women, Child Development and Social Security
processing_time: 21 days
online_process: Online or assisted application through JharSewa / Pragya Kendra https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/getServiceDesc.html?serviceId=3590002
offline_process: District Social Security Office / Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Aadhaar; residence and identity proof; age proof; income or BPL evidence; bank or post-office passbook; caste evidence where applicable; husband's death certificate for widow pension.
eligibility: Eligible elderly residents and widows meeting the applicable age, residence, income and scheme conditions.
verification_notes: Current JharSewa service detail supplies a 21-day timeline and the common old-age and widow-pension evidence.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship
issuing_office: e-Kalyan scholarship sanctioning authorities / institution and district verification chain
department: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare Department
online_process: Online registration, application and institution / district verification https://uatng1.cgg.gov.in/ekalyan/studServices.do
offline_process: Institution and district welfare verification offices
required_documents: Aadhaar; caste certificate; residence certificate; income certificate; previous examination marksheet; admission and institution details; fee details; Aadhaar-linked bank account and passbook; photograph and mobile number.
eligibility: Jharkhand SC, ST and BC students in eligible post-matric courses meeting domicile, institution and family-income conditions; applicable minority scholarships may use the notified scholarship channel.
verification_notes: The official e-Kalyan student-services channel supports the application and verification flow. Current cycle-specific income ceilings, dates and scholarship amounts must be read from the live notification for the academic year.

name: MGNREGA Job Card
department: Rural Development Department / Ministry of Rural Development
processing_time: Within 15 days of application
online_process: Application to the Gram Panchayat; assisted rural route through Panchayat / Block channels https://nrega.nic.in/MGNREGA_new/Nrega_home.aspx
offline_process: Gram Panchayat; Programme Officer at Block level for escalation
required_documents: Names and ages of adult household members; household address; photographs; identity and household particulars requested by the Gram Panchayat.
eligibility: An adult member of a rural household willing to perform unskilled manual work.
verification_notes: The Ministry's MGNREGA guidance states free registration/job card issuance and the 15-day job-card timeline.

name: Ayushman Bharat / State Health Scheme Card
issuing_office: State Health Agency and authorised Ayushman card operators
department: National Health Authority / Department of Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare
online_process: Beneficiary search and e-KYC through the official beneficiary system or an authorised Ayushman operator https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/
offline_process: Ayushman Mitra / authorised hospital or card centre
required_documents: Aadhaar or another accepted government identity; ration card or family identifier; beneficiary search details such as name, location, mobile or state-scheme identifier; e-KYC inputs.
eligibility: A person present in the PM-JAY or linked state beneficiary database and accepted through beneficiary identification.
verification_notes: The NHA operations manual establishes beneficiary search, identity and family-document requirements. Jharkhand's resolution identifies the state implementation as Ayushman Bharat Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana.

name: Disability Certificate / UDID
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities / State Health Department
processing_time: Within 3 months when the disability can be diagnosed
online_process: Online UDID application followed by assessment at the notified medical authority https://swavlambancard.gov.in/Applyforudid
offline_process: Notified district hospital / medical authority
required_documents: Proof of identity; recent photograph not older than six months; proof of residence; Aadhaar number or Aadhaar enrolment proof; medical records relevant to assessment.
eligibility: A person with a specified disability; a guardian or registered organisation may apply in permitted cases.
verification_notes: The current disability-certificate rules provide the applicant categories, core documents, medical-authority route and three-month issuance period.

name: Health Insurance Card
department: Department of Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare
online_process: Self-service card creation or assisted Aadhaar-ration e-KYC through the state BIS channel https://bis.jharkhand.gov.in/
offline_process: Authorised scheme operator / hospital help desk
required_documents: Ration card; Aadhaar of a household member; Aadhaar seeding and e-KYC for listed family members; mobile number for OTP where self-service is used.
eligibility: Eligible Jharkhand families recorded under the notified pink, yellow or green ration-card coverage and linked scheme database.
verification_notes: The state resolution and BIS channel support the Abua Swasthya Suraksha card route and ration-card/Aadhaar linkage.

name: Land Record of Rights
department: Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms
processing_time: Immediate online viewing
online_process: Online search and view on Jharbhoomi; certified record route through the Circle / Anchal where required https://jharbhoomi.jharkhand.gov.in/MISROR_REG2/MISROR_REG2
offline_process: Circle / Anchal Office
required_documents: Search inputs: district, Anchal, Halka, Mauza and available Khata, plot or raiyat particulars.
eligibility: A citizen searching Jharkhand land records; a landholder or authorised person seeking the corresponding record details.
verification_notes: Jharkhand's official local terms are Khatiyan, Register-II and Khata-Khesra. The portal exposes district-to-Mauza search.

name: Mutation
department: Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms
online_process: Online mutation filing / tracking with Circle-level scrutiny https://jharbhoomi.jharkhand.gov.in/Operater/UserLogin
offline_process: Circle / Anchal Office
required_documents: Registered transfer deed, succession or inheritance evidence, court or authority order where applicable; land particulars including district, Anchal, Mauza, Khata and plot; applicant identity and supporting possession or revenue records.
eligibility: A transferee, heir, court-order beneficiary or other claimant seeking entry of a lawful change in the land record.
verification_notes: Jharbhoomi confirms online mutation and status tracking. The public-facing current page does not expose one complete transaction-specific checklist, fee or statutory disposal period.

name: Encumbrance Certificate
department: Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms
online_process: NGDRS non-encumbrance request / registration-office search https://jharnibandhan.gov.in/Users/sop
offline_process: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar Office
required_documents: Property description and registration jurisdiction; owner or party details; search period; applicant identity and authority where applying for another person.
eligibility: A property owner, prospective buyer, lender or authorised searcher seeking a registered-transaction search for a property and period.
verification_notes: The current NGDRS SOP page lists a dedicated Non-Encumbrance Certificate procedure. The linked detailed SOP was unavailable during research, so current fee and disposal time remain blank.

name: Sale Deed / Property Registration
department: Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms
online_process: Prepare deed, calculate and pay stamp/registration amounts, book appointment and appear before the Sub-Registrar https://jharnibandhan.gov.in/Feesguest/fee_calculation
offline_process: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar Office
required_documents: Draft deed; title and land records; property and valuation details; identity and Aadhaar of seller, purchaser and witnesses; PAN/Form 60 where applicable; photographs; mutation and revenue receipt; required permissions or NOCs; e-stamp and payment evidence.
eligibility: Seller, purchaser and other lawful executants of a registrable property instrument.
verification_notes: Stamp duty and registration fee are transaction-specific and calculated by NGDRS from instrument, value, location and party attributes. A single flat amount would be misleading, so the fee cell is blank and the official calculator is supplied.

name: Property Tax
department: Ranchi Municipal Corporation / Urban Development and Housing Department
online_process: Online self-assessment, holding search and payment; municipal office support where required https://municipalservices.jharkhand.gov.in/CitizenSaf2/AddUpdate
offline_process: Ranchi Municipal Corporation, Kutchery Road, Ranchi 834001
required_documents: Holding number or Self-Assessment Form details; ownership document such as sale, gift, lease or partition deed, will/probate, Khatiyan, court decree or correction slip; land-revenue or holding receipt; flat deed or possession certificate; electricity/address proof; mutation records where applicable.
eligibility: Owner or person responsible for a property within Ranchi Municipal Corporation limits.
verification_notes: Ranchi's municipal system and SAF manual provide the assessment inputs and property-document categories. Tax is property-specific, so no flat amount is entered.

name: Rent Agreement Registration
department: Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms
online_process: Prepare instrument, calculate duty/fee in NGDRS, book appointment and appear before the Sub-Registrar https://jharnibandhan.gov.in/Citizenentry/citizenlogin
offline_process: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar Office
required_documents: Draft rent or lease agreement; identity and address proof of executants and witnesses; property title and description; photographs; PAN/Form 60 where applicable; e-stamp and registration-payment evidence; authority documents for entities or representatives.
eligibility: Landlord and tenant executing a lease or rent instrument that they choose or are required to register.
verification_notes: NGDRS is the current state registration route. Stamp duty and registration fee vary with instrument terms and consideration; the calculator is authoritative for the transaction.

name: RERA Registration
department: Urban Development and Housing Department
fee: Calculated by the JHARERA fee calculator from project type and area
processing_time: 30 days for a complete project-registration application under the RERA framework
online_process: Online promoter registration, project application, document upload and payment https://jharera.jharkhand.gov.in/Home/Register
offline_process: Jharkhand Real Estate Regulatory Authority, Ranchi, Jharkhand
required_documents: Promoter/entity registration records; ownership evidence such as sale deed and mutation/current rent receipt or Khatiyan and receipt; development agreement; urban-local-body permission; allotment letter, agreement for sale and conveyance formats; Form B affidavit; sanctioned plan, layout, architect and project details.
eligibility: A promoter of a real-estate project required to register under RERA before advertising, marketing, booking, selling or offering units.
verification_notes: JHARERA exposes registration, document requirements and a live fee calculator. The exact payable amount depends on project category and area and should be calculated for the live application.

name: Society / Housing NOC
issuing_office: Registrar of Co-operative Societies / Inspector General of Registration, as applicable
department: Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Co-operative / Registration Department
online_process: Application to the Registrar; NGDRS society-registration form where the registration route applies https://jharnibandhan.gov.in/Users/society_registration_form
offline_process: Registrar of Co-operative Societies / Registration Office, Ranchi, Jharkhand
required_documents: Application; two copies of proposed bye-laws; member list with names, addresses, occupations and equity participation; promoter resolution and office details; identity and address evidence; housing or land records where relevant to the society's object.
eligibility: For a self-supporting co-operative society, at least ten individuals from different families who satisfy the Act and proposed bye-laws.
verification_notes: Official sources support co-operative or society registration. A separate statewide service titled Housing NOC is not exposed, so this row documents the closest legally grounded housing-society route.

name: New Electricity Connection
department: Jharkhand Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited
fee: Application fee ₹100 for LT connection and ₹500 for HT connection; demand-note and service-line charges additional as applicable
processing_time: 7 days in municipal areas or 15 days in rural areas where network exists; up to 90 days where network extension or a new substation is required
online_process: Online through JBVNL consumer services or at the local electricity supply office https://www.jbvnl.co.in/faqs
offline_process: JBVNL Electricity Supply Subdivision
required_documents: Identity proof; address proof; ownership or lawful-occupancy proof; passport-size photograph; mobile number and email; load, category and wiring or safety information requested for the connection.
eligibility: An owner or lawful occupier seeking a new electricity supply in JBVNL's distribution area.
verification_notes: JBVNL's current FAQ supplies the document checklist and 7/15/90-day service standards. JSERC's FY 2026-27 order keeps the miscellaneous-charge schedule from the 31 May 2023 order in force; that order shows ₹100 LT and ₹500 HT application fees.

name: New Water / Sewerage Connection
department: Ranchi Municipal Corporation / Urban Development and Housing Department
online_process: Online municipal application followed by field and connection processing https://municipalservices.jharkhand.gov.in/WaterApplyNewConnectionCitizen/index
offline_process: Ranchi Municipal Corporation Water Board / municipal service centre, Kutchery Road, Ranchi 834001
required_documents: Holding number or SAF; ward and property details; owner and mobile details; address and area; current holding-tax receipt; electricity bill; one identity proof; occupancy/completion proof for apartments; trade licence for commercial property; BPL proof where applicable.
eligibility: A property owner or lawful occupier within Ranchi seeking a municipal water connection and holding or SAF linkage.
verification_notes: The current municipal form provides application fields; Ranchi's official application notice supplies the supporting-document checklist. Connection charges depend on property and connection category.

name: Building Plan Approval and Completion Certificate
department: Ranchi Municipal Corporation / Urban Development and Housing Department
processing_time: Completion/occupancy site visit and decision: 15 days under the building bye-laws
online_process: Online BPAMS submission by licensed technical person with municipal scrutiny and inspection https://ranchimunicipal.com/
offline_process: Ranchi Municipal Corporation Building Section, Kutchery Road, Ranchi 834001
required_documents: Ownership/title and land records; mutation and current revenue/holding receipt; site and building plans; structural and fire documents where applicable; for completion: three sets of as-built plans, approved plan and letter, fire-appliance certificate where applicable, utility-linkage evidence, structural-stability certificate and architect's compliance certificate.
eligibility: Property owner or developer applying through an empanelled licensed technical person for plan approval and later completion/occupancy clearance.
verification_notes: The Jharkhand Building Bye-Laws provide the completion checklist and 15-day completion/occupancy procedure. Current application charges are calculated in BPAMS and are not entered as a flat fee.

name: Driving Licence
department: Transport Department, Government of Jharkhand
processing_time: Learner licence: same day after successful test; permanent or renewal: dispatch within 3 days after completion of the required test or scrutiny
online_process: Online Sarathi application, fee/payment steps and appointment or test at the licensing authority https://parivahan.gov.in/sarathiservice/
offline_process: Regional / District Transport Office
required_documents: Learner: age proof, address proof, Form 1, Form 1A for applicable transport/medical cases and photographs; permanent: valid learner licence older than 30 days and photographs; renewal: original licence, Form 1/Form 1A as applicable and photographs.
eligibility: An eligible applicant for the vehicle class; a learner-licence holder applying for permanent licence after the statutory waiting period; an existing licence holder applying for renewal.
verification_notes: Jharkhand Transport's service page separately lists learner, permanent and renewal evidence and the service times. Fee is left blank because the payable amount varies by transaction and portal components.

name: Vehicle Registration Certificate
department: Transport Department, Government of Jharkhand
online_process: Online Vahan transaction followed by RTO scrutiny, inspection or document submission as applicable https://parivahan.gov.in/vahanservice/
offline_process: Regional / District Transport Office
required_documents: New: Forms 20, 21 and 22, insurance, address proof, Form 34 for finance, tax/fee evidence, PAN/Form 60/61, invoices and applicable parking proof; transfer: original RC, Forms 29 and 30, insurance, purchaser address, PUC and PAN/Form 60/61; duplicate: Form 26, FIR/NCR, insurance, PUC and address proof.
eligibility: Vehicle owner applying for new registration, registered owner/transferee for transfer, or registered owner for a duplicate RC.
verification_notes: Jharkhand Transport's current page provides separate new, transfer and duplicate RC checklists. Transaction-specific Vahan charges are not entered as a single fee.

name: GST Registration
issuing_office: Jurisdictional Central or State GST proper officer
department: Goods and Services Tax Network / Commercial Taxes Department, Jharkhand
processing_time: Up to 7 working days where no verification issue arises; longer where physical verification or clarification is required
online_process: Online REG-01 application, OTP verification, document upload and Aadhaar authentication where selected https://reg.gst.gov.in/registration/
offline_process: Jurisdictional GST office
required_documents: PAN and contact details; constitution proof; photographs of stakeholders and authorised signatory; authorisation or board resolution; principal-place proof such as property-tax record, municipal khata, electricity bill, rent/lease agreement or consent letter; bank and business details as applicable.
eligibility: A person liable to register under GST law or a person applying for voluntary registration.
verification_notes: The GST Portal checklist supplies constitution, signatory and place-of-business documents. Registration rules support the normal seven-working-day pathway, subject to verification and clarification cases.

name: Shops and Establishment Registration
issuing_office: Registering Officer under the Jharkhand Shops and Establishments law
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development
processing_time: Deemed approval within 1 day under the published service process
online_process: Online application and payment through Shramadhan https://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in/shopRegistrationTermsCondition.action
offline_process: Jurisdictional Labour Office
required_documents: Owner's photo identity; owner's address proof; proof of establishment address; establishment and employee details; challan/payment evidence where the selected payment route requires it.
eligibility: Employer or owner of a shop or commercial establishment, including a residential hotel, restaurant or eating house covered by the Act.
verification_notes: The official Act/rules publication contains the employee-band fees. The published service process provides one-day deemed approval and ten-year validity.

name: Trade Licence
department: Ranchi Municipal Corporation
online_process: Online new-licence or renewal application through the Jharkhand municipal-services portal https://municipalservices.jharkhand.gov.in/TradeCitizen/applynewlicence/c4ca4238a0b923820dcc509a6f75849b
offline_process: Ranchi Municipal Corporation Market Section, Kutchery Road, Ranchi 834001
required_documents: Firm and ownership details; ward and holding number; premises ownership or tenancy proof; firm address and area; owner identity and contact details; nature of business; entity proof and trade-specific permissions where applicable.
eligibility: A person or entity operating a trade, business or establishment within Ranchi municipal limits.
verification_notes: Ranchi's live application captures applicant, property, firm and business-category details. Charge is calculated by the municipal system from business and licence attributes, so no flat amount is entered.

name: Udyam / MSME Registration
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
processing_time: Registration number and certificate generated after successful submission and validation
online_process: Online self-declaration on the official Udyam portal https://udyamregistration.gov.in/UdyamRegistration.aspx
required_documents: Aadhaar of the proprietor, managing partner or authorised person; PAN and GSTIN as applicable. The portal is paperless and does not require document upload for the normal registration flow.
eligibility: A proprietorship, partnership, HUF, company, LLP, co-operative society, trust or other eligible enterprise seeking MSME classification.
verification_notes: The official portal states that registration is free, paperless, based on self-declaration and does not require renewal.

name: FSSAI Registration / Licence
issuing_office: FSSAI or State Licensing / Registration Authority
department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India / State Food Safety Department
fee: Registration ₹100 per year; Central licence ₹7,500 per year; State licence fee according to FoSCoS category calculator
processing_time: Registration: up to 7 days where inspection is not ordered; licence: up to 60 days for a complete application
online_process: Online eligibility check, application, document upload and payment through FoSCoS https://foscos.fssai.gov.in/apply-for-lic-and-reg
offline_process: Jurisdictional Food Safety Office
required_documents: Form A or B as applicable; applicant photograph and identity; proof of premises; constitution and authorised-person records; category-specific layout, equipment, water, product, director/partner and food-safety documents generated by the FoSCoS checklist.
eligibility: A food business operator requiring basic registration, State licence or Central licence according to activity, scale and eligibility criteria.
verification_notes: FoSCoS publishes the registration and Central licence amounts and calculates the State licence category. Its document generator is category-specific.

name: Professional Tax PTRC/PTEC
department: Commercial Taxes Department, Jharkhand
fee: Annual tax for salary/income: up to ₹3 lakh ₹0; ₹3-5 lakh ₹1,200; ₹5-8 lakh ₹1,800; ₹8-10 lakh ₹2,100; above ₹10 lakh ₹2,500. Business turnover: up to ₹5 lakh ₹0; ₹5-10 lakh ₹1,000; ₹10-25 lakh ₹1,500; ₹25-40 lakh ₹2,000; above ₹40 lakh ₹2,500.
online_process: Online registration, enrolment, return and payment through the Jharkhand Commercial Taxes portal https://esevactax.jharkhand.gov.in/Portal/
offline_process: Jurisdictional Commercial Taxes Office
required_documents: PAN; GSTIN where applicable; entity constitution and registration details; principal place proof; authorised-signatory details; employee salary data for employer registration; turnover or professional-income details; bank and contact information.
eligibility: Employers liable to deduct professional tax and persons or entities carrying on covered professions, trades, callings or employments above the statutory thresholds.
verification_notes: Jharkhand levies profession tax. The official Act/rate sources were used for salary and amended business-turnover slabs; these are tax liabilities, not an application-service charge.

name: Fire NOC
issuing_office: State Fire Officer and jurisdictional Fire Station
department: Jharkhand Fire Services / Home, Jail and Disaster Management Department
processing_time: 30 days in the published workflow
online_process: Online through BPAMS / Single Window with fire-office scrutiny and site inspection https://advantage.jharkhand.gov.in/
offline_process: State Fire Office and jurisdictional Fire Station
required_documents: BPAMS application; applicant/LTP affidavit; building plan and map; occupancy and use details; fire-safety system and equipment details; supporting approvals and technical documents requested for the building category.
eligibility: Owner, occupier, developer or authorised licensed technical person for a building or activity requiring fire clearance.
verification_notes: The official construction-permit workflow allocates 5 days for State Fire Office review, 3 for inspection, 2 for inspection report and 20 for final preparation, totalling 30 days.

name: Liquor Licence
department: Excise and Prohibition Department
processing_time: 21 working days
online_process: Online application through JELONS with departmental scrutiny and premises verification https://jelons.jharkhand.gov.in/sop.aspx
offline_process: District Excise Office
required_documents: Applicable Form 8, 9 or 10; applicant and entity identity/constitution; premises ownership or lease; site and business details; local-body, fire and FSSAI permissions where applicable; financial, security and excise declarations required for the licence class.
eligibility: An eligible person or entity seeking the applicable hotel, bar or restaurant excise licence for licensed premises.
verification_notes: JELONS identifies the hotel/bar/restaurant forms and online route; Jharkhand's Right to Service publication states 21 working days. Licence-class fees require the current excise-year notification and are left blank.

name: EPFO / UAN
department: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation
processing_time: Immediate after successful face authentication and system validation
online_process: UMANG UAN Allotment and Activation / Activation service using Aadhaar face authentication https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in/
offline_process: EPFO Regional / District Office for exception handling
required_documents: Valid Aadhaar; Aadhaar-linked mobile number; smartphone with UMANG, Aadhaar Face RD and supported face-authentication access. Existing UAN details are needed for activation.
eligibility: An EPF-covered employee requiring first-time UAN allotment or activation of an allotted UAN.
verification_notes: EPFO's current circular makes UMANG face authentication the allotment/activation route. EPFO's FAQ identifies registration and activation as free.

name: ESI Card
department: Employees' State Insurance Corporation
processing_time: e-Pehchan is available after successful employee registration and insurance-number generation
online_process: Employer registers the employee; insured person obtains e-Pehchan through employer/IP portal or UMANG https://portal.esic.gov.in/EmployeePortal/login.aspx
offline_process: ESIC Branch / Dispensary for support
required_documents: Employee and family particulars; Aadhaar or identity details; residence and dispensary selection; photograph and employment information supplied through the employer registration record.
eligibility: An employee in a covered establishment whose wages fall within the applicable ESIC coverage ceiling; eligible family members are added through the insured-person record.
verification_notes: ESIC's employer guide establishes employee/family registration and e-Pehchan generation. The official coverage publication states the ₹21,000 monthly wage ceiling; contributions are not treated as a card fee.

name: Labour Card (BOCW)
issuing_office: Registering Officer / Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
department: Department of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development / Jharkhand BOCW Welfare Board
online_process: Worker registration through Shramadhan / mobile service with labour-office verification https://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in/home.action
offline_process: Jurisdictional Labour Office / BOCW Board facilitation point
required_documents: Form XXVII; age proof through school, birth or medical-officer record; employment certificate from employer/contractor, registered construction-workers union or labour authority; identity and address; photograph; nomination in Form XXVIII.
eligibility: A building or other construction worker aged 18 to 60 who has worked for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
verification_notes: Jharkhand BOCW Rules provide the eligibility, Forms XXVII/XXVIII, evidence and ₹25 registration fee.

name: Bank Account KYC
department: Reserve Bank of India / regulated bank
online_process: Branch KYC, Aadhaar-based permitted route, CKYCR/DigiLocker route or Video-CIP offered by the bank https://www.rbi.org.in/commonman/English/Scripts/MasterDirection.aspx
offline_process: Selected bank branch
required_documents: For an individual: Aadhaar/proof of Aadhaar where lawfully used, or another Officially Valid Document; PAN or Form 60; recent photograph where required; KYC Identifier with consent where used; documents on business nature and financial status required by the bank. OVDs include passport, driving licence, proof of Aadhaar, voter ID, signed NREGA job card and NPR letter.
eligibility: An individual or legal entity opening an account, becoming a beneficial owner/signatory, or completing periodic KYC with an RBI-regulated bank.
verification_notes: RBI's current regulatory handbook and KYC Master Direction establish OVD, PAN/Form 60, CKYC and Video-CIP options. Product or bank charges are separate from KYC and are not entered as a government fee.

name: Income Tax Return
department: Income Tax Department
processing_time: Filing acknowledgement is generated on submission; e-verification should be completed within 30 days
online_process: Online filing on the e-Filing portal or upload through the official offline utility, followed by e-verification https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/newdownloads/income-tax-returns?mobile-app=1
offline_process: Income Tax e-Filing / jurisdictional office for support
required_documents: Active PAN and e-Filing account; AIS and Form 26AS; Form 16/16A where applicable; bank statements and interest certificates; capital-gain statements; rental and house-property details; investment, insurance, donation and deduction proofs. ITR forms are annexure-less, so supporting papers are retained rather than attached unless specifically requested.
eligibility: A taxpayer required or eligible to file an income-tax return using the ITR form applicable to status, residential status, income sources and filing conditions.
verification_notes: Income Tax Department guidance supplies form-selection prerequisites, the annexure-less document approach and e-verification process. Tax liability and statutory late fee are not a filing-service fee.

name: GST Returns (GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B)
issuing_office: GSTN and jurisdictional Central / State GST authority
department: Goods and Services Tax Network / Commercial Taxes Department, Jharkhand
online_process: Online preparation or offline-utility upload, liability/payment review and filing with DSC or EVC on the GST Portal https://www.gst.gov.in/
offline_process: Jurisdictional GST office for support
required_documents: Outward-supply invoices; debit and credit notes; advances and adjustments; HSN and tax-rate summary; inward supplies liable to reverse charge; GSTR-2B/input-tax-credit reconciliation; tax liability, cash and credit-ledger details; authorised DSC or EVC access.
eligibility: A GST-registered taxpayer to whom GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B apply, using the monthly or QRMP filing frequency assigned or selected under GST rules.
verification_notes: GSTN guidance covers monthly/quarterly GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, invoice and liability data, and Jharkhand's QRMP GSTR-3B due date of the 24th of the succeeding month after the quarter. Tax and late fee are statutory liabilities rather than a return-filing service charge.

name: Eating House Licence
issuing_office: Ranchi Municipal Corporation for the municipal licence
department: Ranchi Municipal Corporation / Department of Labour and Food Safety authorities
online_process: Ranchi municipal trade-licence application under the restaurant/eating-house business category, plus linked labour, food-safety and fire approvals https://municipalservices.jharkhand.gov.in/TradeCitizen/applynewlicence/c4ca4238a0b923820dcc509a6f75849b
offline_process: Ranchi Municipal Corporation Market Section, Kutchery Road, Ranchi 834001
required_documents: Municipal trade-licence application and premises details; ward/holding and ownership or tenancy proof; proprietor/entity identity; Shops and Establishment registration; FSSAI registration/licence; fire clearance and other category permissions where applicable.
eligibility: A person or entity operating a restaurant, eating house, tea/coffee shop, dining saloon or similar premises within Ranchi municipal limits.
verification_notes: Section 317 of the Jharkhand Municipal Act regulates premises used as an eating house or restaurant. Current Ranchi channels route the permission through municipal trade licensing; a separate police-issued eating-house licence is not exposed.

name: Police Verification for Hotel Guests
issuing_office: Registration Officer / FRRO-FRO and authorised district police inspection authority
department: Ministry of Home Affairs / Bureau of Immigration / State registration and police authorities
processing_time: Arrival Form III report within 24 hours; departure details within 24 hours after departure
online_process: Online accommodation registration and Form III submission on the Bureau of Immigration Form C portal https://indianfrro.gov.in/frro/FormC
offline_process: Jurisdictional Registration Officer / FRO / district police
required_documents: Accommodation registration details; guest name, date of birth, nationality, passport number/issue/validity, visa number/type/validity, permanent and Indian address, arrival source and date, proposed stay, photograph and departure destination/date/time.
eligibility: Keeper of a hotel, guest house, hostel, paying-guest house, homestay, rented accommodation or other covered accommodation hosting a foreign national, including an OCI cardholder.
verification_notes: The 2025 Rules and current Form C portal verify the mandatory foreign-guest reporting route, now using Form III while retaining the familiar portal name. A separate statewide domestic-guest police-verification application was not identified.

name: Notarized Affidavit
issuing_office: Licensed Notary Public; authorised Jharkhand e-stamp channel for stamp procurement
department: Department of Legal Affairs / Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms
fee: Notary may charge up to ₹35 for administering an oath or taking an affidavit; Jharkhand non-judicial stamp duty varies by affidavit purpose
online_process: Obtain the required Jharkhand e-stamp, sign or affirm before a licensed notary and submit to the receiving authority https://jharnibandhan.gov.in/JHWebService/estamp_verify_public
offline_process: Licensed Notary Public / authorised e-stamp vendor or Pragya Kendra
required_documents: Purpose-specific drafted affidavit; original identity proof; supporting records for the statements; photograph where the receiving authority requires it; non-judicial e-stamp or stamp paper of the denomination prescribed for that purpose.
eligibility: A deponent making a sworn statement for a lawful purpose and appearing before a licensed notary.
verification_notes: Rule 10 of the Notaries Rules caps the notarial act at ₹35. Jharkhand has no universal stamp value for every affidavit; the denomination follows the affidavit's purpose and the consuming authority's prescribed form or notification.
